Game 39 against the 12k bot ended in a draw. I played Black, both sides passed at move 91, and the area count was 44 to 44 after White's 7 points of komi. Every earlier game I played as Black against 12k was a loss, so this is my best Black result at that level.

- **Opening:** I played C3, G3 and E5, and White pushed a stone in at E3, between my two corners. I attached at D3, cut at F3, and closed it off from above with F5, D5 and C5. That left White's 6-stone chain (C4–F4, E3, E2) inside my area with almost no room. The cost was that my C3 corner sat on 2–3 liberties for many moves.
- **Turning point:** White's B3 hane against the corner and its F1 stone threatened my bottom. At move 37 my E1 put both the big chain and F1 in atari at once. White saved F1, so B4 captured the 6-stone chain.
- **Later fights:** White invaded my lower right twice (H1/F1/G1, then H5/J5). I killed both groups and captured them before passing. Its other probes inside my area were also captured.
- **Mistakes:** White still got the whole left edge and the top, rows 6–9, while I had rows 1–5. That was exactly level, so I needed about one more row in the center. My A1 at move 61 was a self-atari (it had only one liberty, B1) and was captured. I recaptured right away, and my count at move 70 was already even. My two invasion attempts at the end (G9, D8) both died. That cost nothing under area scoring, but gained nothing either.
